source_class: compiled Skyrim plugin / ESO book corpus

storage.note: The batches are the complete per-record manifest and full-text corpus; no book text is omitted from this source-level manifest.

text_encoding: Windows-1252 source strings decoded losslessly to UTF-8; Skyrim/ESO markup retained
continuity_policy: All editor IDs in this supplied compilation use the ZOS prefix, strongly indicating ESO-derived material. The plugin is retained as direct extraction provenance, but compilation membership alone is not treated as per-record proof of original ESO provenance. Per-record provenance can be verified later against ESO game data, UESP, or The Imperial Library.
